digest.component_or_area: bridge command surface and tracker sync operations
propositions: Bridge command surface replaced fragmented Jira-specific operators with a tracker-neutral, Python-first design exposing canonical verbs (setup, check-access, fsck, status, preview, sync, pause, resume) through shared library, CLI, and MCP interfaces.

Canonical exit codes are 0, 1, 2 with legacy adapters preserving historical codes 3, 4, 75 for existing workflows; argument-less reconcile remains non-mutating (dry-run) while argument-less bridge sync is the canonical mutating command.

Bridge implementation is runner-neutral across local, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, and bare environments using shared Python core; tickets-branch delivery is Python-owned via src/rebar/_store/push.py with no workflow-local CAS retry loop.
All installation paths (brew, pip, MCP/uvx) use the same Python-packaged bridge implementation without dependency on editable checkouts or shell scripts.
Pause state is remotely persisted, includes reason metadata, and remains readable by mixed-version fleets; core operations have no required gh CLI dependency.

ADR 0092 records bridge-primary vocabulary and explicit compatibility-adapter decisions with convention-compliant numbering and indexing in docs/adr/README.md; all 20 descendant changes merged and passed Gerrit LLM review.
